crush.definition: An intense feeling of attraction for someone you have not yet got close to.
crush.example: I have a crush on someone from my office, but we have only ever said hello.

intel_general_factor.definition: The general ability that shows up across many different kinds of thinking, usually written g.
intel_general_factor.example: The general factor explains why a person who is good on one test is often good on others.

mia_goalpost_shifting.definition: The moving of the criterion after the other side has met it.
mia_goalpost_shifting.example: Three sources were required, then written external sources were required: that was goalpost shifting.

sleep_apnoea.definition: Repeated pauses in breathing during sleep, usually with snoring and gasping. You usually cannot notice it yourself.
sleep_apnoea.example: My partner says I stop breathing in my sleep, so I will ask about sleep apnoea.
